title: Personal Capital Net Worth Balance Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalcapital:networth balance_usd=*
| stats sum(balance_usd) as total_value, avg(balance_usd) as avg_value by account_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks account type values by total and average balance across Personal Capital net worth events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `balance_usd` values for each Personal Capital net worth event and review total and average balance by account type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total balance.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly which account type shows the biggest balance numbers in your Personal Capital net worth data.
